name: pure-insights-command-center
description: Operational admin dashboard with RBAC, real-time WebSocket alerts and Snowflake cost attribution (Pure Storage case study 3)

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix backend
